apis.description:
Returns a list of all global notifications in the account for the current user
Any notifications that have been closed by the user will not be returned, unless
a include_past parameter is passed in as true. Admins can request all global
notifications for the account by passing in an include_all parameter.

operations.summary: Index of active global notification for the user
operations.notes:
Returns a list of all global notifications in the account for the current user
Any notifications that have been closed by the user will not be returned, unless
a include_past parameter is passed in as true. Admins can request all global
notifications for the account by passing in an include_all parameter.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: include_past
parameters.description: Include past and dismissed global announcements.

parameters.name: include_all
parameters.description: Include all global announcements, regardless of user's role or availability date. Only available to account admins.

parameters.name: show_is_closed
parameters.description: Include a flag for each notification indicating whether it has been read by the user.

apis.description: Create and return a new global notification for an account.

operations.notes: Create and return a new global notification for an account.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: account_notification[subject]
parameters.description: The subject of the notification.

parameters.name: account_notification[message]
parameters.description: The message body of the notification.

parameters.name: account_notification[start_at]
parameters.description:
The start date and time of the notification in ISO8601 format.
e.g. 2014-01-01T01:00Z

parameters.name: account_notification[end_at]
parameters.description:
The end date and time of the notification in ISO8601 format.
e.g. 2014-01-01T01:00Z

parameters.name: account_notification[icon]
parameters.description:
The icon to display with the notification.
Note: Defaults to warning.

parameters.name: account_notification_roles
parameters.description:
The role(s) to send global notification to.  Note:  ommitting this field will send to everyone
Example:
  account_notification_roles: ["StudentEnrollment", "TeacherEnrollment"]

apis.description:
If the current user no longer wants to see this account notification, it can be closed with this call.
This affects the current user only.

If the current user is an admin and they pass a remove parameter with a value of "true", the account notification
will be destroyed. This affects all users.

operations.summary: Close notification for user. Destroy notification for admin
operations.notes:
If the current user no longer wants to see this account notification, it can be closed with this call.
This affects the current user only.

If the current user is an admin and they pass a remove parameter with a value of "true", the account notification
will be destroyed. This affects all users.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: remove
parameters.description: Destroy the account notification.

message.description: The message to be sent in the notification.
message.example: This is a test of the notification system.

start_at.description: When to send out the notification.

icon.description: The icon to display with the message.  Defaults to warning.

roles.description: (Deprecated) The roles to send the notification to.  If roles is not passed it defaults to all roles

role_ids.description: The roles to send the notification to.  If roles is not passed it defaults to all roles

author.description: The author of the notification. Available only to admins using include_all.
